paragraphs_en: Production automation covers Kincsem Park Thoroughbred/Galopp meeting dates and physical venue identity. Official programme files remain a separate reviewed path for richer post-time evidence. Harness coverage is confirmed in reviewed material but is not claimed as part of the automatic Galopp route, and nationwide completeness is not claimed.
